name: @avatark/world-adaptation-contracts
description: Renderer-neutral contracts for Sprint 15's bounded world-adaptation domain: AdaptationSignal/AdaptationPressure/AdaptationRule/AdaptationDecision/AdaptationEffect/WorldAdaptationResult. Typed, closed, per-domain effect vocabulary -- no universal mutable property bag, no psychology, no engagement/reputation score, zero franchise content.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
